name: Kaggle datasets on Ontario accessibility
reason: Checked on 2026-11-16. The relevant Kaggle dataset, Toronto Accessibility and Disability Data, repackages City of Toronto open data (accessible parking stalls, park and civic-building washrooms, library branches, TTC stops). Its Kaggle licence field reads Other (specified in description). Nothing was imported from Kaggle: the same files were retrieved from the City of Toronto on 2026-11-16 and imported from the publisher, which states the licence itself. Without a login the Kaggle dataset search answered one query, with two results that both repackage Canadian public data, and returned HTTP 404 for five other queries, so the pipeline could not complete a wider search.

name: City of Toronto Museums and Cultural Centres washrooms
reason: Retrieved 2026-11-16 under the Open Government Licence - Toronto (10 rows with Washroom?, Accessible? and Gender Inclusive? columns). The file has an address and no coordinates. Records are stored by 0.5-degree cell and this pipeline does not geocode, so the rows were not imported.

name: City of Toronto Traffic Beacon and Pedestrian Crossover resources
reason: Retrieved 2026-11-16 under the Open Government Licence - Toronto (358 beacons, 496 crossovers). Neither resource has an accessibility column. Not imported. The Traffic Signal resource of the same package is imported as toronto-traffic-signals.

name: City of Toronto Pedestrian Network segments without a stated sidewalk
reason: 16,356 of the 87,105 segments retrieved on 2026-11-16 are published as having no sidewalk, a partial sidewalk, a laneway without a sidewalk, a roadway under development, or no description on a road. Their line is the roadway. A path record is read as somewhere a person can travel, so these segments were left out. The other 70,749 segments are imported as toronto-pedestrian-network.

name: City of Ottawa Sidewalks (topographic polygons)

name: City of Ottawa parks inventory layers 5, 7, 8 and 23, and O-Train stations
reason: Reachable on 2026-11-16 under the City of Ottawa Open Data Licence Version 2.0. Layer 5 is a joined view of City facilities that the service did not page; the same facilities are imported from City_Facilities/MapServer/5 as ottawa-recreation-facilities. Layer 7 (91 infrastructure points, such as light switch locations) has no filled ACCESSIBLE value. Layer 8 (1,092 dog-designation polygons) repeats the parks of layer 24, which is imported as ottawa-parks. Layer 23 (609 pathway-link polygons) has a blank ACCESSIBLE value on every row. O-Train station polygons have no accessibility column. Not imported. Public Drinking Water Fountains, City Facilities for Recreation Activities and library locations, which shared this entry, are imported as ottawa-drinking-fountains, ottawa-recreation-facilities and ottawa-library-locations.
